title: Hyperbolicity Cones Without Semidefinite Lifts
main_claim: There is a real homogeneous hyperbolic polynomial p_Q (built from a PSD-valued quadratic matrix map Q: R^330 -> Sym_{20N-1}) whose closed hyperbolicity cone is not a spectrahedral shadow. This disproves the Projected Lax Conjecture and hence the generalized Lax conjecture.
coverage: I read all sections and the appendix line by line. Sec. 2: I checked by hand that Phi_y(W) = sum_j B_j^T W B_j, that the line-determinant identity holds with degree n(n+1), and the Schur-complement proof that E_Q is exactly a projection of an affine section, with no closure taken. Sec. 3: I checked the rank-stratum dimensions (194/193/185), that the kernel of dpi is (JH_0)^perp, the 9 forced annihilators, the a=b=0 rank<=9 exclusion and the translation/dilation independence algebra, the finite-fiber/frontier dimension argument, the uniform rank-correction contraction, and the D_eps scaling giving eps^4 A^{-1} -> C_Ybar. Sec. 4: I checked the Grassmannian incidence count 4h^2-(j-d_*)N<0, the eigen-decomposition limit argument (F=W, F_0!=0, A_n^{-1}->C), and the construction of g and the PSD property of Q. Sec. 5: I checked the patch membership, the residual identity tr(g[G-GU(U^TGU)^{-1}U^TG]), the block identity C=eps^4 iota C_PP iota^T, the rank-1 limit with range spanned by w_P and iota_0 w_P=w giving alpha w^Tgw<0, the finite positive extension, the Taylor/Gram near-feasibility with the max-rank mixing step (O(eps^b)), and the final O(eps^8) vs -kappa eps^4 estimate. Sanity check: the moment functional cannot come from a genuine measure, because a deformed rank-20 T off the 20-point locus is not a measure, so the epsilon^4 violation does not contradict convexity. Appendix: verify_certificate.py is not in the release, so I wrote my own exact mod-32003 computation at a random orbit parameter with a random full tangent. It reproduces rank T=20, T|_L nondegenerate, dim H_0=28, rank Sym^2K=136, K*linear onto all 84 pure cubics, rank D=302, tangent-space dim 194, and bordered rank 623 (so rank F>=19 and dim JH_0=321 along the arc). I did not check the specific F_7 minors digit by digit; my independent generic computation covers the same claims.

issues.description: The appendix cites an accompanying script verify_certificate.py, but it is not shipped in the release folder. This affects reproducibility only, not correctness: the stated minors are meant to stand on their own, and an independent recomputation confirms all the claimed ranks.
issues.evidence: The preprint directory contains only the PDF, README.md and the build/source tex/bib files. My own mod-p computation (random point and tangent) gives rank D=302, bordered rank 623, Sym^2K rank 136 and cubic-spanning rank 84, matching the table (A.rank-sums).
